pnp:ListInstance.Title: DocumentIndex
pnp:ListInstance.Description: One row per file in scope. Maintained by Flow E (backfill) and Flow F (delta). Read by Flow A to resolve affected documents without walking the tree.

Field.Name: UniqueId
Field.Description: SharePoint file GUID. Primary key.

Field.Name: FileName
Field.Description: Leaf file name including extension.

Field.Name: ServerRelativeUrl
Field.Description: Full server-relative path of the file.

Field.Name: ParentFolderUrl
Field.Description: Server-relative path of the containing folder. Queried by Flow A.

Field.Name: Extension
Field.Description: Lower-case extension including the dot, e.g. .docx

Field.Name: SizeBytes
Field.Description: File size. Used by output validation size bounds.

Field.Name: TimeLastModified
Field.Description: SharePoint last modified timestamp.

Field.Name: Depth
Field.Description: Folder depth below the root folder. Diagnostics and walk sizing.

Field.Name: DocumentRole
Field.Description: Source documents are regenerated. Outputs are written to. Templates trigger runs. Archived rows are previous output versions.

Field.Name: TemplateName
Field.Description: For outputs: which template produced this document. Drives cost filter F1.

Field.Name: TemplateFingerprint
Field.Description: For outputs: fingerprint of the template version that produced this document. Drives cost filter F3 (skip already-current).

Field.Name: LastSeenRunId
Field.Description: Stamped by every backfill. Rows not seen by a completed backfill are stale, i.e. the file was probably deleted.

Field.Name: IsExcluded
Field.Description: Row retained for audit but never selected as a regeneration source.

Field.Name: IndexedAt
Field.Description: When this row was last written by Flow E or F.

pnp:ListInstance.Title: RegenerationRun
pnp:ListInstance.Description: One row per regeneration job. Created by Flow A, advanced by Flow B, closed by Flow C.

Field.Name: RunId
Field.Description: GUID generated by Flow A.

Field.Name: TemplateName
Field.Description: Template whose publication triggered this run.

Field.Name: TemplateFingerprint
Field.Description: Fingerprint of the template content at trigger time. Compared against the previous completed run to suppress no-op runs (cost filter F2).

Field.Name: TemplateVersion
Field.Description: SharePoint version label of the template file.

Field.Name: Status
Field.Description: Run lifecycle. Flow B only claims items belonging to an Approved or Running run.

Field.Name: PlannedCount
Field.Description: Work items created by Flow A after cost filters.

Field.Name: AgentCallCount
Field.Description: HEADLINE COST METRIC. Reported by Flow C. If this approaches PlannedCount on every run, the cost filters are not working.

Field.Name: IsDryRun
Field.Description: Plan-only run. Work items are created for inspection and never executed.

Field.Name: RequiresSecondConfirmation
Field.Description: Set when PlannedCount exceeds MaxDocumentsPerRun. Circuit breaker.

Field.Name: SummaryMessage
Field.Description: Written by Flow C.

pnp:ListInstance.Title: RegenerationWorkItem
pnp:ListInstance.Description: The work queue. One row per document per run. Written by Flow A, claimed and updated by Flow B. Persisting this state is what makes the job resumable, bounded in run duration, and immune to the 16 MB action output cap.

Field.Name: RunId
Field.Description: Groups items into a run. Queried by Flow B every cycle, so it must be indexed.

Field.Name: SourceUniqueId
Field.Description: SharePoint GUID of the source document. Idempotency key.

Field.Name: SourceUrl
Field.Description: Server-relative path of the source document.

Field.Name: SourceSizeBytes
Field.Description: Size of the source document, copied from the index by Flow A. Flow B's output validation compares generated size against this to detect truncation and runaway generation, so it must be populated at plan time.

Field.Name: TargetUrl
Field.Description: Server-relative path where the regenerated output is written.

Field.Name: ArchiveUrl
Field.Description: Where the previous output was archived before overwriting. Flow D rollback depends entirely on this.

Field.Name: TemplateFingerprint
Field.Description: Recorded so cost filter F3 can skip already-current outputs on a re-run.

Field.Name: Status
Field.Description: Queried by Flow B every cycle, so it must be indexed.

Field.Name: AttemptCount
Field.Description: Bounded by MaxAttempts, then parked as Failed. Unbounded retry on a deterministic failure exhausts quota.

Field.Name: ValidationResult
Field.Description: Why an agent response was rejected before writing.

Field.Name: ClaimedAt
Field.Description: Used with StaleClaimMinutes to reap items stranded by a crashed batch.

Field.Name: ClaimedBy
Field.Description: Flow run identifier that claimed this item. Prevents double processing.

pnp:ListInstance.Title: WalkFrontier
pnp:ListInstance.Description: The folder walk frontier for Flow E. Persisted rather than held in an array variable so the walk is resumable after a failed run, observable while running, and immune to the 16 MB action output cap.

Field.Name: WalkRunId
Field.Description: Groups frontier rows into one backfill pass.

Field.Name: FolderUrl
Field.Description: Server-relative path of a folder awaiting enumeration.

Field.Name: Depth
Field.Description: Depth below the root folder. Supports breadth-first ordering.

Field.Name: Status
Field.Description: Queried every chunk, so it must be indexed.

Field.Name: ErrorMessage
Field.Description: Recorded when a folder cannot be enumerated, e.g. a single folder with more than 5,000 direct children throttling its own call.
